_note: Resources for pages/emergency-hub.html. A resource with a contact (REGION:number) takes its number, source and check date from REGIONAL_EMERGENCY_DATA in assets/js/emergency-sos.js, so numbers are never typed twice. Other resources are pages of this site. lastReviewed stays null until a person has reviewed the resource: do not guess a date. See docs/EMERGENCY_HUB.md.
